hebrews.4.p1.b1.text: Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.

hebrews.4.p1.b2.text: For we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.

hebrews.4.p1.b3.text: Now we who have believed enter that rest. … And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.

hebrews.4.p2.b4.text: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner:

hebrews.4.p2.b5.text: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”

hebrews.4.p2.b6.text: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”

hebrews.4.p3.b7.text: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

hebrews.4.p3.b8.text: There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

hebrews.4.p3.b9.text: For whoever enters God’s rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from His.

hebrews.4.p3.b10.text: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience.

hebrews.4.p4.b11.text: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, … It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

hebrews.4.p4.b12.text: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.

hebrews.4.p5.b13.text: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.

hebrews.4.p5.b14.text: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.

hebrews.4.p5.b15.text: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
